<thought>To create a single-step retrosynthesis, I will locate a retrosynthetic template that corresponds to the Peterson elimination (formation of a C‑C double bond while breaking a trimethylsilyl group and an aliphatic hydroxyl). I will search the template catalog for reactions that form a C‑C double bond.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "C=C(C1=CC=C(OC)C=C1)C2=CC=C(OC)C=C2",
  "functional_groups_formed": ["C-C double bonds"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
